title: Path connectivity of Dirac-minimal metrics on a closed connected spin manifold in dimension two or four
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The key core is a rank-at-least-two result for Dirac variation pairings: quaternionic spinor identities and unique continuation exclude rank-one degeneracy except for the identified conformally flat torus case. This gives the codimension control needed to avoid nonminimal-kernel strata along metric paths, including the smooth Frechet case; abstract transversality alone would omit that core.
author: Bernd Ammann; Mattias Dahl
